positive_snippets: Hotel is at prime location. Staff behaviour is very polite and helpful. Outside food is also allowed.

Located at a convenient place. Quite nearby Sarita Vihar Metro Station. Rooms can be taken on Rent on hourly basis also. Very neat and clean room, AC, comfortable beds, TV and washroom. Good enough for a short stay. Especially good for parents who come with their children to give competitive exams at Sarita Vihar Centre.
